facts.text: The University of St. Thomas requires first-year students to live on campus for a second year under its Two-Year On-Campus Living Requirement.

sources.title: Housing for Current and Returning Students​ - Minnesota
sources.quote: Please remember that first-year students are required to live on campus for their second year. We guarantee space in our residence halls for all current first-year students going into their second year.
